column1: # tests/fixtures/pr-slug/same-part.tsv - the second half of the PR-slug
# contract: when do two owner or repo names name the SAME thing on GitHub?
# bin/fm-merge-policy-lib.sh's fm_merge_same_part owns it. The two sides of every
# comparison are written by different hands - a clone origin as the captain typed
# it, a PR url as the forge returned it - so a byte-exact match would read a
# case-only difference as a mismatch and let a forbidden merge through. Folding
# cannot loosen it the other way: case-folded owner/repo names are unique on
# GitHub, so two that fold alike ARE the same repo.
# The logbook connector's same_repo_part (connector/firstmate/lb-fm-compose.sh)
# is byte-identical to fm_merge_same_part today, so every row here is an
# agreement. That is exactly why the rows are worth writing down: this half is
# the one that currently matches, and the fixture is what says so out loud if it
# stops matching.
# TAB-separated. "#" starts a comment line. "~" is the empty string. Fields:
#   a
# a
